FAQ

Questions merchants ask us

Which areas do you deliver to?

All 27 governorates of Egypt. Delivery is committed within 2 days in Cairo & Giza and 4 days in other governorates.

How and when do I receive my cash?

Your balance updates as soon as an order is delivered. We send settlement reports twice a week and you can request a payout anytime, by InstaPay, bank transfer, bank deposit or free cash delivery with pickup.

How can my customers pay?

Cash on delivery, InstaPay or mobile wallets.

Do you handle exchanges and returns?

Yes. Exchanges are delivered and collected in the same visit, and we pick up returns and bring them back to you.

Does Deliveric work with Shopify?

Yes. Our free Deliveric Egypt app on the Shopify App Store syncs your unfulfilled orders, fulfils them in bulk and sends live status updates back to Shopify. We also integrate with WooCommerce.

Can customers open the parcel before paying?

You decide per shipment: allow inspection before payment, allow partial delivery, or keep the parcel closed until paid.

How do I get prices for my areas?

Send us your details using the form below or on WhatsApp, and our team will share pricing for your areas and volume.
